# betterado_workitemquery_folder (Resource)

Manages a work item query folder in Azure DevOps.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "betterado_project" "example" {
  name = "my-project"
}

resource "betterado_workitemquery_folder" "example" {
  project_id = data.betterado_project.example.id
  name       = "my-folder"
  area       = "My Queries"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the work item query folder.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project.

### Optional

- `area` (String) The root area for the folder ('Shared Queries' or 'My Queries'). Mutually exclusive with 'parent_id'.
- `parent_id` (String) The ID of the parent folder. Mutually exclusive with 'area'.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the work item query folder.
